stories.headline: Arkheron targets Early Access today with a free opening weekend
stories.summary: Bonfire Studios' isometric competitive action game is scheduled to enter Early Access on November 27 on PC and consoles. Teams of three fight through a multi-floor tower or compete in a 3v3 arena, building their abilities through equipment combinations. The free Friend Pass grants full access during the opening weekend and lets players join friends who own the game afterward. Steam had not yet confirmed the release live at publication.

stories.headline: Shark Mart launches on PC with a 20% introductory discount
stories.summary: Polden Publishing's underwater management comedy launched November 26. Players run a shop as sharks disguised as dolphins, serving customers and hiding a secret kitchen from the fish police. It supports solo and online cooperative play. Steam lists a 20% launch discount through December 10.

stories.headline: Ubisoft denies a company-wide generative AI mandate
stories.summary: Responding to reports that developers feel pressured to use generative AI, Ubisoft says teams are encouraged to explore the technology but projects are not required to use it. The company's statement does not directly address the specific claim that teams must justify excluding AI from game pitches.

stories.headline: GitHub deletes a post promoting unofficial GTA 6 PC port efforts
stories.summary: PC Gamer reports that GitHub removed a social media post praising an unofficial project aiming to make PlayStation 5 executables run on Windows and Linux. The post explicitly referenced efforts involving Rockstar's latest game. This is not an official PC release announcement, and Rockstar's website continues to list only the console versions.

stories.headline: Split Brain Samsara launches with two players sharing one body
stories.summary: Kusa Games released its online cooperative puzzle adventure on November 26. One player controls movement and physical interactions while the other explores the spiritual realm and sees different clues. Both must communicate to escape a mysterious station. Steam lists a 10% introductory discount through December 3.

stories.headline: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration targets today's PC launch
stories.summary: Vahov games and Spaghetti Cat are scheduled to release a relaxing first-person restoration game on November 27. Players clean and assemble 2,655 glass fragments into six chapel windows, unlocking magical tools and uncovering the glassmaker's story without deadlines or failure penalties. Steam had not yet confirmed availability at publication.

stories.headline: Marvelous seeks to cut 65 jobs through voluntary retirement
stories.summary: The Japanese publisher behind the Story of Seasons and Rune Factory franchises plans to reduce its PC and console division by 65 employees while increasing collaboration with external developers. Voluntary applications run from December 14 to January 8, with departures expected by March 31, 2027. The company says its consumer games business remains a core part of its operations.
